1: // Meteor Dodge Game – minimal implementation
2: (() => {
3:   // Load sound effects (small data URLs)
4:   const sounds = {
5:     thrust: (() => {
6:       const a = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAAAB3AgAEABAAZGF0YQgAAAAA');
7:       a.loop = true;
8:       return a;
9:     })(),
10:     crash: new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAAAB3AgAEABAAZGF0YQgAAAAA'),
11:     pickup: new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAAAB3AgAEABAAZGF0YQgAAAAA')
12:   };
13: 
14:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
15:   if (!canvas) return; // canvas must exist
16:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
17:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
18:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 400;
19:   // Pre‑generate stars for background
20:   const starCount = 80;
21:   const stars = [];
22:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
23:     stars.push({
24:       x: Math.random() * width,
25:       y: Math.random() * height,
26:       size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
27:       alpha: Math.random(),
28:       delta: (Math.random() * 0.02 + 0.01) * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1), // twinkle speed
29:     });
30:   }
31: 
32:   // Game state
33:   let ship = { x: 50, y: height / 2, w: 30, h: 15, dy: 0 };
34:   const exhaust = []; // ship exhaust particles
35:   const meteors = [];
36:   const fuels = [];
37:   let lastSpawn = 0;
38:   let lastFuel = 0;
39:   let elapsed = 0; // seconds survived
40:   let fuel = 10; // seconds of extra fuel
41:   let gameOver = false;
42:   let lastTime = performance.now();
43: 
44:   // Input handling (arrow up/down or W/S)
45:   const keys = {};
46:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
47:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
48: 
49:   function update(dt) {
50:     // Ship movement
51:     ship.dy = 0;
52:     if (keys.ArrowUp || keys.w) ship.dy = -200;
53:     if (keys.ArrowDown || keys.s) ship.dy = 200;
54:     ship.y += ship.dy * dt;
55:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - ship.h, ship.y));
56:     // Thrust sound
57:     if (ship.dy !== 0) {
58:       if (sounds.thrust.paused) sounds.thrust.play();
59:     } else {
60:       if (!sounds.thrust.paused) {
61:         sounds.thrust.pause();
62:         sounds.thrust.currentTime = 0;
63:       }
64:     }
65:     // Emit exhaust particle
66:     exhaust.push({
67:       x: ship.x,
68:       y: ship.y + ship.h / 2,
69:       size: 3,
70:       alpha: 0.8,
71:       speed: 200,
72:     });
73: 
74:     // Spawn meteors every 0.8‑1.2 s
75:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > 800 + Math.random() * 400) {
76:       meteors.push({
77:         x: width,
78:         y: Math.random() * (height - 30),
79:         w: 30,
80:         h: 30,
81:         speed: 150 + Math.random() * 150,
82:       });
83:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
84:     }
85: 
86:     // Spawn fuel pickups occasionally (every 5‑8 s)
87:     if (performance.now() - lastFuel > 5000 + Math.random() * 3000) {
88:       fuels.push({
89:         x: width,
90:         y: Math.random() * (height - 20),
91:         w: 20,
92:         h: 20,
93:         speed: 100,
94:       });
95:       lastFuel = performance.now();
96:     }
97: 
98:     // Update meteors and exhaust particles
99:     // Update meteors
100:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
101:       const m = meteors[i];
102:       m.x -= m.speed * dt;
103:       if (m.x + m.w < 0) meteors.splice(i, 1);
104:     }
105:     // Update exhaust particles
106:     for (let i = exhaust.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
107:       const p = exhaust[i];
108:       p.x -= p.speed * dt;
109:       p.alpha -= dt;
110:       if (p.alpha <= 0) exhaust.splice(i, 1);
111:     }
112:     // Update fuels
113:     for (let i = fuels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
114:       const f = fuels[i];
115:       f.x -= f.speed * dt;
116:       if (f.x + f.w < 0) fuels.splice(i, 1);
117:     }
118: 
119:     // Collision detection
120:     function rectCollide(a, b) {
121:       return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
122:     }
123:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
124:       if (rectCollide(ship, meteors[i])) {
125:         gameOver = true;
126:         sounds.crash.currentTime = 0;
127:         sounds.crash.play();
128:         break;
129:       }
130:     }
131:     for (let i = fuels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
132:       if (rectCollide(ship, fuels[i])) {
133:         fuel += 5; // add 5 s of fuel
134:         sounds.pickup.currentTime = 0;
135:         sounds.pickup.play();
136:         fuels.splice(i, 1);
137:       }
138:     }
139: 
140:     // Timer handling
141:     elapsed += dt;
142:     fuel -= dt;
143:     if (fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
144:   }
145: 
146:   function draw() {
147:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
148:     // gradient background
149:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, width, 0);
150:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
151:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
152:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
153:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
154:     // twinkling stars
155:     stars.forEach(s => {
156:       s.alpha += s.delta;
157:       if (s.alpha <= 0 || s.alpha >= 1) s.delta = -s.delta;
158:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${s.alpha})`;
159:       ctx.beginPath();
160:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
161:       ctx.fill();
162:     });
163:     // ship exhaust particles
164:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
165:     exhaust.forEach(p => {
166:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,165,0,${p.alpha})`;
167:       ctx.beginPath();
168:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
169:       ctx.fill();
170:     });
171:     // ship – simple triangle with glow
172:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0f0';
173:     ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
174:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
175:     ctx.beginPath();
176:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
177:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y);
178:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
179:     ctx.closePath();
180:     ctx.fill();
181:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
182:     // meteors – circular with gradient
183:     meteors.forEach(m => {
184:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x + m.w / 2, m.y + m.h / 2, 0, m.x + m.w / 2, m.y + m.h / 2, m.w / 2);
185:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#e44');
186:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#511');
187:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
188:       ctx.beginPath();
189:       ctx.arc(m.x + m.w / 2, m.y + m.h / 2, m.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
190:       ctx.fill();
191:     });
192:     // fuels – bright pickups
193:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
194:     fuels.forEach(f => {
195:       ctx.beginPath();
196:       ctx.arc(f.x + f.w / 2, f.y + f.h / 2, f.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
197:       ctx.fill();
198:     });
199:     // UI
200:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
201:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
202:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
203:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${elapsed.toFixed(1)}s`, 10, 20);
204:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${fuel.toFixed(1)}s`, 10, 40);
205:     if (gameOver) {
206:       // Stop thrust sound on game over
207:       if (!sounds.thrust.paused) {
208:         sounds.thrust.pause();
209:         sounds.thrust.currentTime = 0;
210:       }
211:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
212:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
213:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
214:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
215:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
216:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
217:     }
218:   }
219: 
220:   function loop(timestamp) {
221:     const dt = (timestamp - lastTime) / 1000;
222:     lastTime = timestamp;
223:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
224:     draw();
225:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
226:   }
227:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
228: })();

(End of file - total 228 lines)
</content>
